dedupe_keys.name: yukon geotechnical borehole points yukon geological survey compilation incl alaska highway borehole database with ground ice logs

description: This Government of Yukon dataset maps geotechnical boreholes compiled by the Yukon Geological Survey, published on the territory's open data portal from GeoYukon. The entry read on 2026-09-28 explains that the points come from site investigations of soil and rock beneath proposed structures, and that the logs matter for the territory's permafrost database because they record ground ice at depth; sources include the Northern Climate Exchange, the land branch of Community Services, the abandoned mines programme, the Transportation Engineering Branch, an Alaska Highway borehole database and agricultural soil profiles. The data come as an ArcGIS Online layer, Shapefiles and XML metadata, last updated in January 2022, with access through the portal's interface for programs. Coverage is Yukon, Canada, wherever the contributing agencies drilled. Access is free under the Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: the compilation merges sources of different age and quality, the attributes in the files were not inspected, and updates are ad hoc. It supports climate adaptation and hazard studies, such as screening sections of the Alaska Highway or community sites for ice-rich permafrost that thaw could destabilise. Related records: the SIRIUS Alaska permafrost infrastructure inventory and the permafrost embankment dam compendium.
